key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ! ジムに着いたみたいだね

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムは 大ホールに直結してるの。どこにいても ジムに着いたら 助言を求めて連絡できるよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: AME: Ah, you're going to fight Shade...
en: AME: Ah, you're going to fight Shade...
ja: アメ: ああ シェイドと戦うんだね……

key: Okay. He's at the old Abandoned Power Plant, right? If nothing's changed, it's probably super dark up there.
en: Okay. He's at the old Abandoned Power Plant, right?  If nothing's changed, it's probably super dark up there.
ja: うん。彼は 廃発電所にいるよね? 変わっていなければ あそこは とても暗いはず

key: Shade uses that darkness to strengthen his Ghost-type attacks, but you can take a similar strategy!
en: Shade uses that darkness to strengthen his Ghost-type attacks, but you can take a similar strategy!
ja: シェイドは その闇でゴーストタイプの技を強めてくる。でも 同じ手は こっちも使えるよ!

key: The machinery up there is on the fritz, and the rampant energy can give your Electric attacks an extra spark! ...Or they could short it out. Either way...
en: The machinery up there is on the fritz, and the rampant energy can give your Electric attacks an extra spark! ...Or they could short it out. Either way...
ja: あそこの機械は不調で 暴れるエネルギーが でんきの技に力をくれる! ……逆にショートするかも。どちらにしても……

key: But, if you can find a way to get that machinery back online during the battle, the lights should come on too!
en: But, if you can find a way to get that machinery back online during the battle, the lights should come on too!
ja: でも 戦いの最中に 機械を動かし直せれば 明かりもつくはず!

key: That way, you can get rid of his shadow-based strength, and get a reliable boost to your Electric and Steel attacks yourself!
en: That way, you can get rid of his shadow-based strength, and get a reliable boost to your Electric and Steel attacks yourself!
ja: そうすれば 影による強化を消して でんきとはがねの技を 確実に強められるよ!

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: がんばってね!

key: AME: ...Actually, on the matter of Shade,
en: AME: ...Actually, on the matter of Shade,
ja: アメ: ……そうだ シェイドのことだけど

key: I spoke to him, and realized that I owe you an apology.
en: I spoke to him, and realized that I owe you an apology.
ja: 彼と話して あなたに謝らなきゃいけないと 気づいたの

key: That train that you first came into the region on...
en: That train that you first came into the region on...
ja: あなたが最初に この地方へ来たときの あの列車……

key: Apparently, I'm the entire reason that it was targeted.
en: Apparently, I'm the entire reason that it was targeted.
ja: あれが狙われたのは 全部わたしのせいだったみたい

key: It's thanks to him that I was able to save you in time,
en: It's thanks to him that I was able to save you in time,
ja: 間に合ってあなたを助けられたのは 彼のおかげ

key: But you would never have been in danger if it weren't for me.
en: But you would never have been in danger if it weren't for me.
ja: でも わたしがいなければ 危ない目にも 遭わなかった

key: I'm sorry for that.
en: I'm sorry for that.
ja: 本当に ごめんね

key: ...I would like to say that it'll be taken care of in full, but I've also been asked not to--
en: ...I would like to say that it'll be taken care of in full, but I've also been asked not to--
ja: ……全部わたしが引き受けると言いたいけど そうしないでとも 頼まれていて——

key: Er, actually, this doesn't matter.
en: Er, actually, this doesn't matter.
ja: えっと やっぱり 今はいいや

key: Apologies; good luck on your challenge.
en: Apologies; good luck on your challenge.
ja: ごめんね。挑戦 がんばって

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールでは 誰も出ないようだ……

key: ZAPDOS: Zaaap!
en: ZAPDOS: Zaaap!
ja: サンダー: ザァァップ!
